breakpoints.note: By this point the witness has already passed CDF header, SAT, SSAT, directory, and short-stream parsing, and `file_trycdf` is entering the `\05SummaryInformation` user-stream path that leads to the crashing property parser.

First project-code statement on the crashing path that materializes the attacker-controlled bytes and length into `cdf_info`, the parser state later used by every `cdf_read` while building the SummaryInformation stream.

breakpoints.code: DPRINTF(("o=%" SIZE_T_FORMAT "u l=%d(%" SIZE_T_FORMAT "u), t=%" SIZE_T_FORMAT "u s=%s\n", o4, l, CDF_ROUND(l, sizeof(l)), left, inp[i].pi_str.s_buf));
breakpoints.note: The earlier `o4 + l > left` check only proves that `l` bytes exist inside the current section. It does not prove there is a NUL terminator before the end of the heap-backed stream buffer, so `%s` can walk off the allocation.
